US AI-hardware leadership (ARM, MRVL, PLTR) sets a global risk-on tone, but Indonesian tech names trade on local liquidity and policy, not AI fundamentals, requiring a country-specific lens.

Favor SLIS (e-payment) and IT (infrastructure) for domestic volume growth, not US beta. Trim if IDX tech breaks below +0.91% support; rotate into hardware-linked suppliers if US semis hold gains.

Prioritize AMRT and TRI for resilient earnings, but take profits on speculative spikes like AGAR and LUCY. Watch for pullbacks in ADES to add, as consumer staples remain a defensive core amid IDX volatility.
